나도 모르게 영어를 쓸 때 목소리를 더 낮게 깔게 되는 경향이 있어.
```
(original) I unconsciously tend to split out more lower pitch using eng.

(corrected) I unconsciously tend to speak in a lower pitch when I use English.

(natural) My voice naturally drops when I switch to English.
```
